bluetooth_confirm.title: Govee {model}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the Govee {model} found via Bluetooth?

data_description.address: The 12-digit Bluetooth address printed by the device or shown by a BLE scanner.
data_description.model: The model printed on the device. A conflicting supported model advertised at this address is rejected.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Govee model
reconfigure.description: Select the exact model advertised by this device. The config entry and entity identity are preserved.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid 12-digit BLE MAC address.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device.
error.model_mismatch: The device at this address advertises a different supported model.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the device.

abort.no_options: This model has no configurable Effect Studio options
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Govee model

invalid_segments.message: Select at least one valid segment.

invalid_custom_effect.message: The saved effect is invalid or unavailable.

invalid_effect_target.message: {entity_id} is not a Govee BLE light.

effect_permission_denied.message: You are not allowed to control {entity_id}.

effect_apply_failed.message: The saved effect could not be applied.

music_mode_replaced.title: Music mode select replaced
music_mode_replaced.description: The select {old} has been removed. Choose a music mode from the light's effect list instead, and update any automations or scripts that used the old select.

unsupported_model.title: Unsupported Govee model
unsupported_model.description: This config entry identifies model "{model}", which this integration cannot safely control. Reconfigure the device with a supported model.

paint_segments.name: Paint segments
paint_segments.description: Paint one or more color groups onto supported addressable segments.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: List of {segments: [1-15], rgb_color: [R, G, B]} groups; each color is sent as one packet.

set_segment_color.name: Set segment color
set_segment_color.description: Set a single color on the given segments (1-15).

set_segment_brightness.name: Set segment brightness
set_segment_brightness.description: Set brightness on the given segments (1-15).

apply_custom_effect.name: Apply custom effect
apply_custom_effect.description: Apply a saved custom effect through a supported Govee light entity.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Name of the saved custom effect.

effect_id.name: Effect ID
effect_id.description: Stable ID of the saved custom effect. Use either Effect or Effect ID.

set_video_settings.name: Set video settings
set_video_settings.description: Write the video sheet as one frame: capture mode, picture preset, saturation and sound effects. Anything left out keeps the device's current value. Camera models only.

game_mode.name: Game mode
game_mode.description: On for Game, off for Movie.

picture_preset.name: Picture preset
picture_preset.description: The app's picture preset for video mode.

sound_effects.name: Sound effects
sound_effects.description: React to sound as well as picture.

set_video_blank_screen.name: Set blank-screen detection
set_video_blank_screen.description: Turn blank-screen detection on or off, keeping the device's own durations.

get_dreamview_candidates.name: List DreamView candidates
get_dreamview_candidates.description: List the Govee devices configured here that could join this sync centre's DreamView group.

read_dreamview_group.name: Read DreamView group
read_dreamview_group.description: Read the DreamView group this device is holding: whether it is on, how many members it has, and each member's connection state.

identify_dreamview_members.name: Identify DreamView members
identify_dreamview_members.description: Work out which device sits in each DreamView slot and remember it. The sync centre never reports its members' addresses, so this finds out by observation: it disconnects one slot at a time and sees which device starts advertising, then reconnects it. Group membership and Area Config are left untouched.

settle.name: Settle time
settle.description: Seconds to watch for a disconnected member to start advertising.

set_dreamview_group.name: Set DreamView group
set_dreamview_group.description: Replace this sync centre's DreamView group. NOT READ-BACKABLE: no query returns group membership, so the previous group cannot be recovered afterwards.

members.name: Members
members.description: Each member's address, and optionally its per-zone Area Config.

set_dreamview_switch.name: Turn DreamView on or off
set_dreamview_switch.description: Start or stop the DreamView group this device is holding.

set_dreamview_member_brightness.name: Set DreamView member brightness
set_dreamview_member_brightness.description: Set one member's brightness. Requires same-brightness to be off, which otherwise drives every member from one level.

index.name: Member index
index.description: Zero-based position of the member in the group.

set_dreamview_same_brightness.name: Set DreamView same brightness
set_dreamview_same_brightness.description: Drive every member from one brightness level, or let per-member levels apply.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether all members share one brightness.

set_dreamview_sound_effects.name: Set DreamView sound effects
set_dreamview_sound_effects.description: Turn sound effects on or off for the DreamView group, and optionally set their softness.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the group reacts to sound.

softness.name: Softness
softness.description: How soft the sound reaction is, 0-100. Both values share one command, so leaving this out keeps the group's current softness rather than resetting it.

delete_dreamview_group.name: Delete DreamView group
delete_dreamview_group.description: Remove the group this device is holding, freeing its sub-devices to be reached directly. NOT UNDOABLE: membership cannot be read back, so the group cannot be rebuilt from here.

release_ble.name: Release Bluetooth
release_ble.description: Drop this device's Bluetooth link and stay off it, so the Govee app or a DreamView sync centre can take it. Use a window covering the whole session: a sync centre that loses the race does not retry.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to stay off the link. 0 clears an existing hold.

release_all_ble.name: Release Bluetooth on every device
release_all_ble.description: The same hold, applied to every configured Govee device. Works while a device is unavailable, which an entity service cannot.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to stay off the links. 0 clears existing holds.

init.title: Effects
init.description: Choose which Effect Studio categories appear in the Studio and on the light entity.

data.prefix_effect_names: Prefix effects with their category (e.g., "Scene: Aurora")
